claim: The Nix manual's canonical statement (since release 1.1, 2012, retained verbatim through current manuals): 'The private network namespace ensures that builders cannot talk to the outside world (or vice versa): each build only sees a private loopback interface. This also means that two concurrent builds can listen on the same port (e.g. as part of a test) without conflicting with each other.'
stance_target: gap-04: upstream explicitly endorses in-sandbox listen-on-a-port tests; parallel flake check builds can't conflict on the harness port
